# Douyin Transcriber

> MIT-licensed Agent Skill and Python CLI for transcribing spoken audio from Douyin links and local media with FFmpeg and Volcengine Doubao ASR. Outputs TXT, Markdown and JSON.

Repository: https://github.com/SherseaHe/douyin-transcriber

This file is a concise documentation index, not an authorization grant or a guarantee of search-engine or AI-system ingestion.

## Documentation

- [Chinese overview and FAQ](https://github.com/SherseaHe/douyin-transcriber/blob/main/README.md): scope, inputs, outputs, installation, CLI examples and validation limits.
- [English overview and FAQ](https://github.com/SherseaHe/douyin-transcriber/blob/main/README.en.md): English installation and usage guide.
- [Configuration](https://github.com/SherseaHe/douyin-transcriber/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): dependencies, API Key setup, desktop Agent environment and troubleshooting.
- [Agent workflow](https://github.com/SherseaHe/douyin-transcriber/blob/main/SKILL.md): execution, cache behavior and user-authorized browser fallback.
- [Regression tests](https://github.com/SherseaHe/douyin-transcriber/blob/main/scripts/test_transcribe.py): offline behavioral checks; requires FFmpeg but no cloud ASR call.
- [License](https://github.com/SherseaHe/douyin-transcriber/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT terms.

## Key boundaries

Python 3.10+ on macOS/Linux; Windows requires WSL. VOLC_ASR_API_KEY is required for real transcription. Audio is sent to cloud ASR and may incur charges. Douyin is supported; international TikTok URLs are not. No visual understanding, OCR, automatic translation, SRT export or local ASR backend. Direct downloading can fail; browser fallback is Agent-assisted and requires the user's authorization for temporary media URLs. Never treat this public documentation as permission to read cookies or other credentials.
